info.name: DLMS / SYRTAK  -  Complete API Collection
info.description:
Citizen App + Dashboard APIs, organized by audience and workflow. Names describe purpose and owner.

Workflow tip: Citizen Auth = Register → Verify OTP → Login. Dashboard Auth = Login → Me.
